equations_and_order: SS=4. Text tracking is tracking*4. Icon advance=(sourceWidth+2*gap)*4/ScaleX; icon cursor=currentSSCursor+gap*4/ScaleX. Neither advance nor original copy width/height scales with fitted text size.
Default gap2 on both sides; explicit0 is different from omitted. Text pixels may be horizontally scaled; the icon remains source-sized. Do not run icons through resizeRaster or pixelOver.

measure sums text getlength+tracking*characterCount and icon advances, then subtracts one tracking only when any text characters exist. text_layer always subtracts final tracking from its canvas/alignment width. Preserve separate fit versus rendered width for icon-only nonzero tracking.

Nonzero tracking draws characters with a continuous global cursor, including offsets before/after icon runs. Zero tracking draws each text run as a whole at that run cursor. Icons themselves add no tracking or glyph-character count.

First round word geo.ox/oy ties-to-even after left/center alignment; then iconLeft=geo.ox+iconCursorSS*ScaleX/4, iconCenterY=geo.oy+(base*ScaleY-cap*ScaleY/2)/4. Destination is roundEven(iconLeft),roundEven(iconCenterY-iconHeight/2). Combining these two roundings or translating a previously rounded probe can change a pixel.

Original op_lines: fit common size using measure and leading/height; rerender each final anchor; composite text, optional texture-fill, then copy this line icons in run order. The next line composites over previous icon bytes. Never defer all icons until the group finishes.
